name: proofgate-synthetic-demo
note: Synthetic, account-free fixtures. Receipt ids are opaque; commit SHAs are derived from fixed labels; nothing here is customer data.

happy.description: Every mandatory requirement has fresh, live, passing evidence for the exact revisions; one advisory requirement is DEFERRED and stays visible.

unsatisfied.description: The same policy with planted problems: one requirement in every non-PASS status. Mandatory requirements are not satisfied, so the release is not accepted.

tampered.description: An artifact was edited after its receipt recorded the hash. This is rejected as malformed input: exit 2, artifact_hash_mismatch, and no report is written.

duplicate.description: A manifest that declares one requirement id twice. Rejected as malformed input: exit 2, manifest_duplicate_requirement_id, and no report is written.
